newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Jasatera wins industrial park contract.
newsitem.headline: Jasatera wins industrial park contract.

text.p: Malaysian construction and real estate company Jasatera Bhd said on Thursday it has been awarded a 293 million ringgit contract to build an industrial park in eastern Terengganu state.
In a statement, Jasatera said Korakyat Corp Sdn Bhd had also recently acquired a 25 percent equity interest in it by buying 4.8 million shares in the open market.
Korakyat is developer of the Electric Vehicular Industrial Park and which awarded the construction contract to Jasatera.
The statement did not say how much Korakyat paid for the stake. Jasatera stock was suspended since Wednesday, and was last traded at 24.00 ringgit.
Jasatera said the first phase of the Terengganu project is expected to start before the end of the year and would be ready within a year's time.
